items.name: Wind-down
items.purpose: Three in, six out: an easy slope into rest

items.name: Sleep slow
items.purpose: A pause at the top and a long way out, for lying in bed

items.name: Anchor
items.purpose: Four in, a short hold, six out to settle a racing mind

items.name: Pace
items.purpose: Six in, a beat, six out: slow and even

items.name: Triangle
items.purpose: Three equal sides: in, hold, out

items.name: Deep box
items.purpose: Box breathing with a five count, for when four feels short

items.name: Empty pause
items.purpose: Rest after the breath out, where the mind is quietest

items.name: Bright
items.purpose: Quick and light to wake up. Stop if you feel dizzy.
